name: Vanta Network
description:
Welcome to Vanta Network! We are a crossplay (Java & Bedrock) PvP and nations server.

We focus on sword, spear, and mace PvP. Our goal is to build a server that keeps its focus on PvP and a strong community with its players.

We just launched! Join now and claim your spot early! Compete in events and win prizes across build comps, PvP comps, most kills, richest nations, and much more!
